prompts.title: Spec clip plan
prompts.summary: Plans a spec clip for a brand you want to work with, from their product page.
prompts.prompt: I want to pitch [brand]. Here's their product page: [paste the text]. Plan a 15-second spec clip: three hook options for the first two seconds, five shots, the line I say on camera, and the on-screen words. No claims the product page doesn't make.
prompts.use: Shoot it before you pitch, and send it with the email.

prompts.title: Hook test
prompts.summary: Ten first-two-second hooks for one product, sorted by type.
prompts.prompt: Write ten hooks for the first two seconds of a UGC video for [product]. Two each: a problem, a surprising use, a reaction, a comparison, a question. Each under ten words, and say what's on screen during it.
prompts.use: Film three, post the one that holds.

prompts.title: Deal recap email
prompts.summary: Recaps a brand deal in one email so nothing is left to memory.
prompts.prompt: Write a recap email to [brand contact] after we agreed: [deliverables], [deadline], [price], [usage rights and how long], [whitelisting yes/no], [raw footage yes/no], [payment terms]. Ask them to reply "confirmed". Friendly and short.
prompts.use: Send it the same day you agree, before you film.
